rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Notturno ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Vittorio Barni (1914-1999) (Italy, 1981).
Introduced in Italy by Rose Barni in 1981 as 'Notturno'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Flowrers dark purplish red. Strong fragrance. 35 petals. Full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Bushy, upright. Large, dark green foliage.
rows.Parentage:
Papa Meilland ® (Hybrid Tea, Meilland, 1963) ×
Unnamed Seedling
rows.Notes: Rose Barni says the blooms of Notturno are large and a dark velvety red -- a worthy companion to 'Magia Nera'.

colour: Dark red. Flowrers dark purplish red.
